summary: Frontend E2E test of 'Investigar con AI' flow inside ContentEditor (both /admin/resources/new and /admin/articles/new). All 6 requested behaviors verified end-to-end against the live preview URL. Admin login OK, ai-research-btn visible next to Asistente AI on both editors, dialog opens, research returns 4 options, applying option 0 populates fields (title 'LIHEAP en Oregon: ayuda para pagar la calefacción del hogar', category 'Servicios públicos', etc.) and shows research-generated confirmation + 'Contenido con apoyo de AI' badge. Image generation succeeded within ~20s and applied a /api/media/file/... URL to featured_image (no error toast). Save-draft succeeded with 'Guardado correctamente' toast and the new record appears in the Recursos list. Cleaned up the created test record via API afterwards.
critical_code_review_comments: AIResearch.jsx: applyOption merges AI fields into values via setValues but does NOT set values.used_ai=true. The 'Contenido con apoyo de AI' banner in ContentEditor renders based on values.used_ai; it currently works only because the backend /ai/generate-post response includes used_ai=true in fields. If the backend response schema ever drops that flag, the badge silently disappears. Consider explicitly forcing used_ai:true on the frontend for safety.

AIResearch.jsx line 18 reset() clears options/generated/imagePrompt but NOT topic/instructions. This is fine (user can re-run) but the dialog visually retains previous inputs when reopened after close — actually the Dialog onOpenChange resets when closing so state persists across reopens via component staying mounted. Not a bug, but worth documenting.
genImage() sets featured_image directly with the /api/media/file/... path returned by backend; verified this is a same-origin URL that renders correctly in the ImageUpload preview via mediaUrl(). OK.

No loading/disabled state on the 'Cerrar y editar' button while image is generating — user could close mid-generation and lose the image (imagePrompt state is lost on dialog close via reset()). Minor UX suggestion: disable close while busy==='image'.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one test Recurso 'LIHEAP en Oregon: ayuda para pagar la calefacción del hogar' via the AI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AIResearch integration into ContentEditor works E2E. Preview URL is https://recursos-or.preview.emergentagent.com (from frontend/.env). AI research call took ~10-20s; generate-post ~10s; image generation ~15-20s in this run. Field 'field-featured_image' was populated with a relative /api/media/file/... URL. Note: the very first preview URL (use-env-vars.preview...) shows 'Preview Unavailable' — always read frontend/.env before running.
